meta.title: Amabwiriza y’ikirango
meta.description: Ikirango cya Linse: logo, amabara, imyandikire, ikirahure n’icyuma, imigendere n’imvugo, hamwe n’ipaki ya logo yo gukuramo.

hero.title: Ikirango
hero.lead: Isura ya Linse, imigendere yayo n’imvugo yayo: uburyo bumwe ku rubuga, ku bicuruzwa byacu no ku butumwa bwose dutangaza.

idea.title: Ibya IT byose ahantu hamwe
idea.lead: Ikipe imwe ishinzwe porogaramu, ibikoresho zikoreraho n’ubufasha butuma byombi bikomeza gukora. Ikirango kigaragaza icyo gitekerezo mu buryo butatu.

night.title: Kuva mu ijoro ujya mu mucyo
night.text: Paji zitangirira ku cyatsi cyijimye nk’ijoro, zikagenda zicya: ibigoye bigahinduka ibisobanutse.

metal.title: Icyuma
metal.text: Chrome na aluminiyumu irimo imirongo mito bigaragaza ibikoresho: ibintu bikozwe ngo biramba.

glass.title: Ikirahure
glass.text: Ikirahure kibonerana, gifite urumuri rw’icyatsi, kigaragaza porogaramu: zisobanutse kandi zinoze.

idea.together: Iyo bihujwe biba igikoresho: umubiri w’icyuma na ecran y’ikirahure. Buri shusho nyamukuru ikoresha kimwe muri byo cyangwa byombi.

logo.title: Logo
logo.lead: Ikimenyetso LS n’izina Linse, byanditse muri Archivo SemiBold. Koresha amadosiye ari mu ipaki ya logo; ntuzigere uyashushanya bundi bushya.

tiles.mark: Ikimenyetso cyonyine: amafoto ya porofayili, favicon, ibikoresho

space.title: Umwanya w’ubusa
space.text: Ubugari bw’umurongo uhagaze wa L, ku mpande zose.

size.title: Ingano nto ishoboka
size.text: Ikimenyetso: uburebure bwa 16 px; logo itambitse: ubugari bwa 72 px.

legal.title: Izina ryemewe n’amategeko
legal.text: Linsetech Ltd, mu nyandiko, mu masezerano no mu gice cyo hasi cy’amapaji.

donts: Kuyiha ibara ritari mu mabara yacu
Kuyishyira ku mafoto yuzuyemo ibintu byinshi
Kuyongeraho igicucu cyangwa ibindi bintu, uretse ikirahure n’icyuma byemewe

colour.title: Amabara
colour.lead: Ijoro ni ryo shingiro ry’ikirango, icyatsi ni cyo gikurura amaso. Icyatsi kigarukire hafi ku gice kimwe cya cumi cya buri gishushanyo.

gradients.nightfall: Umugoroba (Nightfall): igice cyo hejuru cya paji

colour.a11y: Icyatsi ku Ijoro gishobora gukoreshwa ku nyandiko (hafi 8.7:1). Ku ibara ry’inyuma rikeye, inyandiko y’icyatsi yandikwa mu Cyatsi 600 (#15803D); icyatsi kibengerana gikoreshwa ku bishushanyo no gushimangira gusa.

materials.title: Ikirahure n’icyuma
materials.lead: Ikirahure n’icyuma bigaragazwa muri sitidiyo yijimye: itara nyamukuru ry’umweru woroheje, n’urumuri rw’icyatsi rukikiza impande ruturutse hasi n’inyuma. Buri shusho igira ikintu kimwe nyamukuru.

chrome.title: Chrome
chrome.text: Irabengerana nk’indorerwamo, ikagaragaza sitidiyo yijimye irimo ibara ry’icyatsi, umwijima n’urumuri bitandukanye cyane. Ikoreshwa ku bikoresho no ku kimenyetso LS.

glass.title: Ikirahure
glass.text: Kibonerana kandi kibyibushye, ntigihishe ibiri inyuma yacyo: gifite impande zikase zihengamye zifata urumuri rw’umweru woroheje, n’urumuri ruke rw’icyatsi rugaragara inyuma yacyo. Gikoreshwa kuri porogaramu, amakuru n’amakarita.

materials.combined: Bihujwe: ikadire ya chrome ifashe ikirahure, nk’uko igikoresho gifata ecran yacyo.
materials.grain: Utudomo duto nk’utw’amafoto ya kera (4–6 %) dushyirwa ku mashusho yijimye, ntitujya ku nyandiko.

type.title: Imyandikire
type.lead: Archivo ku byo usoma byose, Archivo Narrow mu nyuguti nkuru ku byo ureba vuba. Zombi ziboneka ku buntu kuri Google Fonts.
type.note: Imitwe iba ifatanye (umwanya hagati y’imirongo 1.0–1.1, hagati y’inyuguti −2 %). Ikinyarwanda gifata umwanya urenzeho 15–20 % ugereranyije n’Icyongereza: ugisigire umwanya.

graphic.title: Imiterere y’ibishushanyo
graphic.lead: Inguni zitaburungushuye ahantu hose, imirongo mito icagaguye, kare nto y’icyatsi nk’ikimenyetso, na kare imwe yubakirwaho imbonerahamwe, amakarita n’imigendere.

dashed.title: Imirongo icagaguye
dashed.text: 1 px, umweru woroheje ku 15 % ku Ijoro, umukara ku 15 % ku ibara rikeye.

marker.title: Ikimenyetso
marker.text: Kare y’icyatsi ya 6 px ishyirwa imbere y’imitwe n’intonde.

index.title: Imibare y’urutonde
index.text: 01, 02… muri Archivo Narrow, ku ntambwe, ku masilayidi no ku bice.

icons.title: Udushushanyo
icons.text: Udushushanyo tw’imirongo, umurongo wa 1.5 px ku buso bwa 24 px, impera zigororotse.

motion.title: Imigendere
motion.lead: Ibintu biza vuba bigatuza buhoro. Inyandiko igaragara umurongo ku murongo cyangwa inyuguti ku nyuguti, 3D igenda uko umuntu amanura paji, kandi videwo zisubiramo ku mbuga nkoranyambaga zimara amasegonda 6–10, nta hantu hagaragara zihurira.

items.outQuad: Out quad: ibisubizo bito bya UI

voice.title: Imvugo
voice.lead: Twandika nk’uko injeniyeri mwiza asobanura: mu buryo bworoshye, bufatika, nta gukabya.

plain.title: Byoroshye
plain.text: Interuro ngufi n’amagambo asanzwe. Sobanura ijambo cyangwa urireke.

specific.title: Bifatika
specific.text: Imibare nyayo, ahantu nyaho, intambwe nyazo. Nta mubare dutangaza tudashobora kwemeza.

confident.title: Twizeye
confident.text: Tuvuga ibyo dukora n’uko tubikora. Nta “twahinduye byose”, nta “turi aba mbere muri Afurika”.

local.title: Iby’iwacu
local.text: Icyongereza n’Ikinyarwanda, buri rurimi rwandikwa uko rusanzwe ruvugwa, nta guhindura ijambo ku ijambo.

pairs.do: Dutunganya buri mudasobwa igendanwa mbere y’uko isohoka aho dukorera.
pairs.dont: Dutanga ibisubizo bya IT bigezweho kandi biruta ibindi byose.

pairs.do: Ibibazo bikomeye, umutekinisiye abyitaho mu isaha imwe.
pairs.dont: Ubufasha bwihuta nk’umurabyo, bwo ku rwego rw’isi, 24/7/365!

applications.title: Aho bikoreshwa
applications.lead: Imiterere imwe kuri buri butumwa: logo hejuru ibumoso, izina ry’urukurikirane hejuru iburyo, hasi umurongo ucagaguye uriho aderesi, n’ikintu kimwe nyamukuru. Ubutumwa bwo ku Ijoro n’ubwo ku ibara rikeye busimburana, ku buryo amafoto ari kuri porofayili agaragara nk’ikibaho cya dame.
